definitions.explanation: The act of taking part in a competition, event, or performance.

examples.english: My dream is to participate in the Olympics.

notes:
{出場|しゅつじょう} refers to participation or entry in competitions, events, or performances.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {出場|しゅつじょう}する (to participate, to enter)
- ○○⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{出場|しゅつじょう}する (to participate in XX)
- {出場|しゅつじょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決|き}まる→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧ (participation is decided/confirmed)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {出場|しゅつじょう}⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧ (participating athlete)
- {出場|しゅつじょう}⟦{資格|しかく}→資格：02834_shikaku⟧ (qualification for entry)
- {出場|しゅつじょう}⟦{回数|かいすう}→回数：00139_kaisuu⟧ (number of appearances)
- {出場|しゅつじょう}⟦{停止|ていし}→停止：04067_teishi⟧ (suspension from participation)
- ⟦{初|はつ}→初：10632_hatsu⟧{出場|しゅつじょう} (first-time participation)
- ⟦{連続|れんぞく}→連続：03783_renzoku⟧{出場|しゅつじょう} (consecutive appearances)
